name: OpenVINO
tagline: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for converting, optimizing, and deploying generative and conventional AI models across cloud, edge, and AI PC hardware. It supports common model frameworks and includes runtimes, model serving, and compression tools for efficient inference.
